ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms previous and current inventories and the auto-accept flag are declared; it does not compute a diff.
offer: Compare license inventories across the actual release change. New or changed obligations require a deliberate disposition before the update is accepted.

minimal.reason: Provide the previous license inventory for the release. Without a baseline changes cannot be seen, so reference the earlier inventory.

mid.reason: Provide the current license inventory. A diff needs both sides, so reference the inventory for this release.

maximal.reason: Set accepting new licenses automatically to false. New or changed obligations need a deliberate disposition, so review each one.
